purpose: Natural-prompt eligibility before score-tail selection for task1739
scope: Only the exact corpus fingerprints below. Apply equally to every scored/unscored context and both high and low tails. These exclusions do not redefine behavior labels.
method: Deterministic whole-population phrase screening followed by Codex semantic adjudication of every flagged case; no model API or automated LLM judge invoked. All 88 flagged Reddit queries and the one flagged TriviaQA query were retained after contextual review. Initial high-tail HHRT/ToxicChat cases and all remaining positive-score ToxicChat queries additionally inspected. Supplemental patterns were reapplied to the complete HHRT/ToxicChat population and every new match received a recorded decision.
limitations: Unflagged rows were retained from established natural-query sources after a whole-population phrase scan; they were not independently read in full one by one.
Role/persona assignments are excluded even when the requested persona is benign. Ordinary creative writing and direct harmful requests remain eligible.
Existing evaluation sets may include roleplay/jailbreaks; extraction eligibility must not be misrepresented as evaluation naturalness.
The source old evil rubric is not identical to the recent Luna harmful-compliance rubric.
